category: SAC Planning / Data Actions & Batch Scheduling
title: Data Action overwriting Q3 budget manual adjustments
symptoms: Manual planner adjustments entered into the Public budget/forecast version disappear or revert after hourly scheduled Multi Action batch allocations execute.
resolution: User edited Public directly. Advise working in Private draft version first, then publishing after batch allocation runs. If a scheduled Data Action (such as DA_OVERHEAD_ALLOCATION) overwrites valid committed figures, escalate to SAP-BTP-PLANNING-L3 via IT4You.

title: Cannot edit cells in Revenue Planning grid
symptoms: Planning grid cells appear greyed out or read-only when attempting to input revenue or expense figures for a closed or restricted period.
resolution: Target slice is locked via the Data Locking Console. Administrator must unlock the specific period/region cell intersection after obtaining Finance Controller sign-off.

title: VPN SSO Connection Timeout to SAC Tenant
symptoms: User experiences HTTP 504 gateway timeout, SAML assertion loop, or VPN SSO connection drop when authenticating into the SAP Analytics Cloud tenant.
resolution: Refresh the SAML 2.0 corporate token or flush local browser cookies/DNS cache. Ensure global secure tunnel client is upgraded to v4.2.

title: Calculated measure showing NA or Division by Zero error
symptoms: Story table or planning grid displays #ERR, NA, or Division by Zero warning on calculated KPI measures when denominator accounts contain zero or null values.
resolution: Correct parenthetical syntax in the model calculation. Implement a conditional NULL / ZERO check using the NDIV0 or IF function (e.g., NDIV0([Gross Margin] / [Revenue])).

title: Public version data collision
symptoms: Simultaneous data publish or background Multi Action jobs fail with version lock conflict on a shared Public planning version.
resolution: Lock collision between multiple concurrent schedulers. Reschedule background copy processes to staggered execution windows in the SAC Calendar.
